svg.title: 2019 to 2020: the geographic denominator changes
svg.desc: Europol's original 2019 EU28 reporting cohort has 119 attack entries, including 64 from the UK. Removing the UK leaves 55 EU27 entries in 2019, compared with 57 in the original EU27 2020 cohort. A later official revision reports 56 for 2020. These are reported statistical entries, not a physical incident census.

g.text: reported attack entries · original annual cohorts unless noted
Fixed geography does not harmonize national reporting or classification.
The 2020 revision is shown separately; it does not replace the original cohort.
source: TE-SAT 2020 pp. 84–85; TE-SAT 2021 pp. 99–100; later TE-SAT revision · npcsignals internal draft
